column2: Walk me through your last move. What happened to the furniture you didn't take with you?
column3: Sold or gave it away cheap: listed it online, posted in a group chat, or left it for friends.
column4: Threw it out, donated it, or left it on the curb because there wasn't time to sell it.
column5: Paid to move or store it, even though it wasn't worth much.

column2: When you moved into your current place, how did you get your furniture?
column3: Bought it new: spent more than planned, plus delivery and assembly.
column4: Bought or picked it up second-hand: cheaper, but arranging pickup was a hassle.
column5: Used hand-me-downs or free stuff, or still don't have everything needed.

column2: What was the most frustrating part of dealing with furniture during a move?
column3: The cost: new furniture and moving help add up fast.
column4: The logistics: no car or truck, heavy lifting, tight move-out deadlines.
column5: Dealing with strangers: haggling, no-shows, and coordinating times.
